text: I'm here to let you out.
source_text: I'm here to let you out.

text: Hey, I don't care about that, just get me outta here!
source_text: Hey, I don't care about that, just get me outta here!

text: I stole some water. Hey, I was thirsty! It wasn't like I hurt somebody.
source_text: I stole some water. Hey, I was thirsty! It wasn't like I hurt somebody.

text: You took more than your rightful share.
source_text: You took more than your rightful share.

text: Ah, that's nothing. I'll get you out.
source_text: Ah, that's nothing. I'll get you out.

text: I would've died without the water. It was only a cupful. Just enough to keep me alive. You gotta get me out of here! I'm going insane.
source_text:
I would've died without the water. It was only a cupful.
 Just enough to keep me alive. You gotta get me out of here!
 I'm going insane.

text: I think I'll let the authorities deal with you.
source_text: I think I'll let the authorities deal with you.

text: Where does the water come from?
source_text: Where does the water come from?

text: They pump it up from the wells below. There is a manhole in the cell next door that leads to the old vault. This is the source of the water. If it wasn't for those ones below, we would be a lot better off.
source_text:
They pump it up from the wells below. There is a manhole

text: It's difficult to make the old tech work properly, sometimes. The glowing ones lash out whenever we go down there. Us ghouls just leave them alone. And the big mutants don't seem to care one bit.
